name: Psionic Demilich, Awakened
body:
PSIONIC DEMILICH, AWAKENED
CR 18

XP 153,600
Awakened demilich lashunta telepath 14
NE Tiny undead (psionic)
Init +7; Senses darkvision 60 ft., pierce the veils; Perception +19; Aura phrenic overload 80 ft. (DC 26)

DEFENSE

AC 24, touch 20, flat-footed 21 (+3 Dex, +4 natural, +5 profane, +2 size)
hp 147 (14d8+84)
Fort +10, Ref +9, Will +17
Defensive Abilities channel resistance +5, rejuvenation; DR 20/—; Immune acid, cold, electricity, polymorph, psionics, undead traits

Weaknesses torpor, vorpal susceptibility

OFFENSE

Speed fly 30 ft. (perfect)
Space 2-1/2 ft.; Reach 0 ft.
Special Attacks devour soul (DC 27), screams of the forsaken, soulbreaker
Psi-Like Abilities (ML 20th; concentration +26)

Constant—pierce the veils, phrenic overload (DC 26, penalty to AC and DCs, confuses, automatically read minds)
At will—recall death (DC 27), telekinetic force (625 lbs.), telekinetic maneuver (+6 bonus)

Telepath Powers Known (ML 14th; power points: 221; base save DC 17 + power level; concentration +21)

Talents-detect psionics, far hand, unearthly terror
1st-demoralize, inertial armor, mind thrust, mindlink, vigor
2nd-aversion, cloud mind, control sound, feat leech
3rd-battlesense, energy wall, hostile empathic transfer, psionic blast
4th-alienation, fold space, mind control, schism
5th-major ectoplasmic creation, mind probe, psychic crush, upheaval
6th-co-opt concentration, mind switch, temporal acceleration
7th-bend reality, cosmic awareness, psychosis

Discipline Telepathy

STATISTICS

Str 6, Dex 17, Con —, Int 24, Wis 22, Cha 23
Base Atk +7; CMB +3; CMD 27
Feats Ability Focus (devour soul), Deep Focus, Defensive Combat Training, Flyby Attack, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Overchannel, Persistent Power, Psionic Meditation, Quicken Power, Talented
Skills Craft (mechanical) +24, Knowledge (arcana) +24, Knowledge (engineering) +26, Knowledge (history) +24, Perception +19, Sense Motive +22, Spellcraft +24
Languages Abyssal, Aklo, Celestial, Draconic, Infernal, Lashunta; telepathy 400 ft. (can discern telepathic communication within 30 ft.)

ABOUT

Under exceptional conditions, a lich’s full consciousness survives its transformation into a demilich, or a lich’s wandering intellect manages to return to its skull. Such creatures are awakened demiliches and combine the powers and near invulnerability of a demilich with the mind and manifesting prowess of a lich. An awakened demilich has the full manifesting abilities of the lich it was before, and gains Overchannel and Talented as bonus feats. Awakened demiliches keep their original lich Hit Dice, and any mental attributes that are higher than the demilich’s minimums.

They otherwise have all the special abilities and defenses of a demilich, and no abilities of the original lich beyond manifesting and mental attributes. An awakened demilich has a CR of 15, or the CR of the original lich + 3, whichever is higher.
